Structures, A Textbook

Eli Fontaine

Preface

This book grew out of a lecture course.

1. Foundations

We begin with sets and relations.

1.1 Relations

A relation is a subset of a product.

2. Lattices

Lattices are posets with binary meets and joins.

3. Topologies

A topology is a family of subsets closed under union and finite intersection.

Bibliography

Alexandroff, P. Diskrete Raume. Mat. Sbornik, 1937.
Birkhoff, G. Lattice Theory. AMS Colloquium Publications, 1940.
